_about: Public-domain August Hermann Francke (1663-1727, Halle, Pietist and founder of the Halle orphanage) in English for the Word Hoard: Pietas Hallensis (London, 1705), Nicodemus, or a Treatise against the Fear of Man (second edition, 1709), Christus Sacrae Scripturae Nucleus (1732) and A Guide to the Reading and Study of the Holy Scriptures, tr. William Jaques (third edition, 1819), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

francke-pietas-hallensis: Pietas Hallensis: or a Publick Demonstration of the Foot-steps of a Divine Being (London: J. Downing, 1705)
francke-nicodemus: Nicodemus: or, a Treatise against the Fear of Man, second edition (London: J. Downing, 1709)
francke-christ-sum-scripture: Christ the Sum and Substance of all the Holy Scriptures (Christus Sacrae Scripturae Nucleus) (London: J. Downing, MDCCXXXII)
francke-guide-scriptures: A Guide to the Reading and Study of the Holy Scriptures, third edition, tr. William Jaques (London: D. Jaques for J. Hatchard, 1819)

_alternates.francke-copies: Nicodemus 1706, 1801 and 1831; the Footsteps Parts II-III (1710, 1716) and later Pietas Hallensis issues; the Philadelphia Guide
